# Pull request

## Issue

Link the issue. For a small bug or documentation fix without an issue, say so.

## Research

Link the prior issues, pull requests, and
[design decisions](https://github.com/owenlamont/ryl/blob/main/docs/design/decisions.md)
checked. State the behaviour verified against ryl or a reference tool.

## Change

What changed, and why?

## Checks

List the applicable commands run and any gate that could not pass.
